$comment: Mini-app profile, a proposal for the governance framework of «AXA Mini Apps – Citizen Development Boost Factory» (AXA LOS!). Not an official AXA schema.
name: RetroBoard Lite
purpose: Digital sticky-note wall for sprint retrospectives: collect notes in three columns (good / bad / change), vote, discuss one note large, copy the result.
audience: Scrum masters, team leads and every team that regularly looks back on how it works together
benefit: Replaces external online retro tools, where internal topics end up with third-party providers (shadow IT).

owner.deputy: Agile coach or a second scrum master (to be named)

riskLevel.reason: No personal or customer data, no server, no network access, no login. Everything stays in the browser of the person moderating.
risesWhen: several people should write at the same time from their own devices (needs a server or shared storage, e.g. Teams Live Share in the AXA tenant)
content is sent to other systems (e.g. Jira, Confluence, e-mail)
an AI should summarise the notes (texts go to a service)

lifecycle.decommission: Archive the repository and disable GitHub Pages. There is no server-side data to delete.

data.storage: Only in the browser of the person moderating (localStorage). «Neue Retro» deletes everything.
data.noticeInApp: Bitte keine Kunden- oder Personendaten eintragen.

networkAccess: none (loads only files of its own site; enforced by the Content-Security-Policy default-src 'self')
ai: none in the app; built with AI assistance following AGENTS.md

hosting.deployment: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/deploy.yml), only after green tests
hosting.target: Static hosting on an AXA-internal platform for mini apps

security.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
security.checkedAutomatically: tests/guardrails.test.js: CSP, classic deferred scripts, no inline code, relative paths, no external URLs, no network access, no HTML strings, colour tokens, dark mode, profile complete

quality.scope: board logic, votes, sorting, card numbers, summary, timer, saved data, guardrails, profile

limits: One person operates the app (screen sharing). No sync between devices, no login, no connection to other systems.
